name: Precise Finish

features.text: Removes minor swirl marks, holograms and micro marring
Produces a smooth, high clarity, high gloss finish
Ideal final step prior to waxes, sealants or coatings
Balanced micro abrasive blend for professional finishing
No residue, no dusting, long working time

description: PRECISE ™ FINISH is a unique balance of abrasives and cleaners to remove any minor paint imperfections such as swirl marks, holograms, and minor surface imperfections. PRECISE ™ FINISH is the last step in the paint correction process before any additional paint protection products are applied. PRECISE ™ FINISH is body shop safe and does not contain silicone, wax, or fillers.
application: Directions: For use by hand or with a DA Polisher. Apply product directly to a cool surface or a foam applicator. Work product until it is dry. Wipe off excess material with a clean microfiber towel. Formulated to be used with foams pads. DA Orbitals - use 70337 MF finish or 70327 foam finish pads
